description: Tock seems rhythmically bewildered while keeping both feet planted. Both wing-arms lift in a compact shrug, the head tilts sharply, the beak opens slightly in surprise, and one wing tip scratches the side of the head. The metronome tail ticks twice evenly, hesitates off-beat, then makes one cautious corrective tick while three tiny timing lights briefly lose alignment; no punctuation, hopping or added parts. The emotion must read immediately as genuinely surprised and thoughtfully confused, never sad, ashamed, angry or mocking.
